title: Entitlement Engine Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the entitlement engine capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Absent or not-granted denies by default; operator grant transitions to granted; revoke transitions to revoked; revoked/absent block access.

stateModel.description: Per-organisation entitlement keys with granted|revoked state, source, metadata, and update lineage; RLS-isolated.

permissions.description: tenant.entitlements.read for tenants; platform.entitlements.read/write for operators; the policy chain denies before entitlement evaluation.

contracts.description: Org self-read and operator read/patch of tenant entitlements behind ports/adapters.

validation.description: Unknown keys are rejected without audit; invalid tenant ids return errors; feature flags are not entitlements; no cross-tenant leakage.

errorModel.description: Assertion denies with a forbidden outcome; evaluation returns denied; invalid route inputs are rejected.

auditModel.description: Grant and revoke emit entitlement.granted/revoked before the mutation; a failing audit blocks persistence.

readinessModel.description: Deterministic once persistence is migrated; the proof verifies table, RLS, no-secrets, isolation, grant/revoke, and audit-before-change.

proof.description: Unit and runtime proof of entitlement evaluation, persistence, and routes. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; author the UI semantic model before generation.
